name: Clock Reach Balance

instructions.description: Stand on one leg in the center of an imaginary clock face.
Reach the free foot lightly to different positions such as forward, side, and back without fully shifting weight onto it.
Keep the standing knee aligned over the foot and the trunk controlled.
Return to the center between reaches and switch sides when finished.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count each controlled direction as a repetition.

variations.variationDescription: Uses multiple directional reaches instead of a single forward hinge pattern.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Limit the drill to front, side, and back positions.

commentsNotes: Light toe contact is enough; avoid leaning heavily onto the reaching foot.
Keep the pelvis level during each reach.
